content:
Name your skiff. It will be added in the player Airship slips. Under <#863362543585329162>.
You must give a name before you gain the player role.
"the merry widow"  a mostly unused ship, perhaps not for much longer.
"The Skyward Swordfish." Drifts a little too close to the water for anyone's liking.
"Red Aphid". It doesn't look like it should fly, so better to not think how it does it anyway.
"Sunshine Flowers" Its a brightly colored ship that seems to have a slight glow all the time. Harper the pirate said so. 🤣
"Rochambeaus Glory" a somewhat broken down airship a few planks missing with french flags hanging from all possible sides.
"Still Floating" is a battered lifeboat that looks like it should fall out of the sky anytime now.

"The Nightingale" is an old, battered airship, that looks like it's been salvaged multiple times. When it was new, it had a different name, but that name - and its previous owner - has been lost to time.
"The Peaky Blinders" this agile frigate belongs to Cairn.
the ship “Bellona” is small and battered, the white, yellow, and blue paint old and weathering away.  Although she’s certainly seen better days, she has a certain rustic charm to her.
"The Nimble" is a small but capable little airship that looks about to fall to pieces at any moment, but it does honor to its name somehow.

The chipped paint of the *`Evermore`*'s name is always hidden by a tarp draped over her side. An old, weathered set of pennants hanging over the deck is the only vestige of color about the ship: a reminder of a time she may have been brighter.

"The Bismarck It is an airship made mostly in Europe with it's first prototype from Germany  the Bismarck can be maned by at least one person at the least but about 3 at most but what it lacks in man power it gains in storage and speed but it seems to be a very old model that seems to have had other occupants in its past.
Tabula is one of the crewmates on the Bellona
"The dread-not" a makeshift airship, clearly made out in the boonies. The one thing it does not inspire is dread.
"Zephyr".  A small 1-3 person airship that lives up to its name
all airships have a 2 player max
Ok
“The Vestige” is a small, rundown airship. It seems to have a small kitchen located in the lower part with an even smaller room on top.
“Olivia’s Guidance” is a very small airship that reminds Kaizer of happier days containing his very small study. And his room underneath that room.
“The Bon” is a ship that’s… good enough. The official name written on the side of the ship is *The Beloved Bonnie*, but Meorys was never bothered to change the name after receiving it.
"The Sapper" is a proud military grade airship (with a lot of the weapons taken off). It's has a freshly painted owl on the bow

"Eρευνα" (Celestial) is a small scientific exploration vessel that could maybe do with a fresh coat of paint. And better furniture. Still, it looks more like a home than a lot of places in the colonies, just someone else's home.
"Unit 119" is an apartment that happens to fly, when absolutely necessary. Adamantium-infused steel struts holding together taut canvas walls. Light. Cheap.
"The Garden" is a small airship wrapped in vines and covered in well cultivated flowers and plants. The name is barely visible under all the plant life.
"The Trimere" is a 25 foot ship which looks almost like a trireme when viewed from below. It has equipment made for enchanting and maintaining equipment aboard. It's oak finish is rather unassuming.

"Eastwind" has been scratched - not painted - onto the bow, obliterating the old name. Piled high with trash and junk and emitting a thin stream of smoke, this ship is in a state of disrepair and looks to be getting worse.

"Shadow Runner" boasts a dark oak frame with dark silver steel fixtures on it. It's coloring blends it in nicely in the night sky, making this the perfect airship for stealth missions undercover of darkness, exactly what Luard wants.

"The Siren's Song" is dark on the outside and almost as dark on the inside. It is well lived in, and as comfortable as it can be on the limited budget it's owner has. It also comes equipped with a makeshift alchemy lab, where Paeton makes potions, in his free time.

"The Vexed Mastermind" is a small airship that has been modified and changed so much that you are unsure which parts are it’s original. None of these additions seem to add anything of mechanical value, the owner was just bored and thought it would be cool to add extra tail fins.
"The heap" the ugliest and most poorly maintained two passenger airship. It goes from a to b and hasn't fallen apart yet. Looks to be made mostly of moldy driftwood and rusted scraps.

**"The Golden Voice."** Mobile platform of the most reliable news source over radio and air dropped papers in the region. Always in the know, on the move, and filled with charm. It's nimble and fast but is recognizable from all across the city. A golden balloon, purple bladed fans, and a forest woodstained hull with speakers along the sides. The bow of the ship holds one of the largest antennae in the city.

The Iron Maiden is a elegant looking slick air ship that can move silently and fast. It is mainly black with grey and white highlights that make it look elegant. It has silver white tribal designs along it as well. The name is hard to read Iron is in black with a dark gray out line where as Maiden stands out easily in silver and white.

"The Strix" is as much a living place for Secel as a place of worship. Decorated to honor Athena, the ship has all the traits a devoted of Athena would wish: a small place of worship, symbols, and a bit of handicraft.

"L'manskiff" Named by a younger brother, this is small and hastilly put together ship, adorned in reds, blues, whites, and golds. The pattern is simple and the base is a plain black but with the colorings it stands out among a field of gray.
